train_PoseNetwork: train a PoseNetwork model with teacher forcing on motion capture sequences for a specified number of epochs
save_weights_PoseNetwork: save the PoseNetwork model weights to a file using torch.save for later inference
load_weights_PoseNetwork: load PoseNetwork model weights from a saved file to resume training or run inference
cuda_PoseNetwork: move the PoseNetwork model and tensors to CUDA GPU for accelerated training and inference
eval_PoseNetwork: set the PoseNetwork model to evaluation mode disabling dropout and batch normalization updates
